messages:
Casey: Heads-up — NovaHealth submitted an onboarding request (Request NH-0426-7). They want a PHI-sensitive 13B summarizer on Private with HSM/KMS.
OnboardBot: New intake NH-0426-7 created by @harper.nova — intake form: https://redwood.app/intake/NH-0426-7 (automated).
Maria S: @Samir @Elaine can you triage security + infra? Their p95 token latency goal is <120ms and PHI isolation is non-negotiable.
Samir: Quick clarifying Q — do they require fp16 model or is 4-bit quantization acceptable? Memory & infra differ a lot.
Casey: Customer favors lower cost but PHI is top priority. Ask them if 4-bit (GPTQ-style) is tolerable for quality; propose fallback to a smaller model during bursts.
Elaine: I can run the eval suite. Proposed plan: 1) safety (PHI redaction & leakage tests), 2) perf (latency/cost), 3) accuracy/regression on 20 biz-critical prompts. Need 50 representative docs + 20 golden outputs from customer. @Casey can you collect?
Jordan: Also flagging renewal risk — NovaHealth is approaching midterm review. Delays in onboarding = higher churn risk. Recommend prioritizing a 1-week onboarding window and a joint CSM+PS presentation.
Casey: On it — I'll ask Harper for samples and quantization tolerance. I'll prep an enablement doc and runbook for their SRE.
Maria S: Samir — infra ask: private deployment will need air-gapped artifacts + KMS/HSM integration. Can you give a ballpark GPU footprint and cost delta by EOD?
Samir: Ballpark: 13B quantized ~1 x A10G-like node + 1 replica for HA; fp16 will need 2 x A100 (or equivalent), more memory and higher cost. I'll draft detailed numbers and footprint.
Harper (NovaHealth): Thanks — we can provide 50 redacted samples and 20 annotated golden outputs. 4-bit is acceptable if quality remains within ~3% of our baseline. p95 latency is a hard requirement for our SLAs.
Elaine: Great — once samples are in I'll kick off the eval run and share the checklist + results dashboard with NovaHealth.
Casey: :thumbsup: Scheduling kickoff Tue 10am PT, send invite to @harper.nova + CSM. Calendar: https://cal.redwood/meet/NH-kickoff
OnboardBot: Intake NH-0426-7 status updated -> "In Triaged" by Casey.
Casey: Next steps: I will collect samples, Maria to coordinate legal/security touchpoints, Samir to finalize infra estimate, Elaine to prep eval harness. Tagging @Jordan for renewal playbook and prioritization.
file_note: intake thread: PHI-sensitive 13B private onboard; includes triage, infra estimates, eval plan, renewal risk note
